Name: Lots of Kisses
Author: NatrollEXE
Description:
[b][color=#c27ba0][size=4]Lots of Kisses! 💕[/size][/color][/b]

Bring a little more affection, playfulness, and romance into your relationships.

[b][color=#c27ba0]Lots of Kisses[/color][/b] expands the way you can interact with your spouse or dating partner, adding sweet spontaneous kisses, longer affectionate moments, and fun reactions from the people around you.

Run into your partner for a quick [b][color=#c27ba0]Bump Kiss[/color][/b], or stay close to share a lovely [b][color=#c27ba0]Multi-Kiss[/color][/b] sequence. If you get carried away in public, nearby villagers may notice, comment, or react to your romantic display — and your partner might have something to say about it too!
[heading][color=#c27ba0][size=4]Main Features[/size][/color][/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Bump Kiss[/b] — gently run into your partner to give them a quick kiss.[/*]
[*][b]Multi-Kiss[/b] — stay close and enjoy a longer sequence of kisses.[/*]
[*][b]Public Reactions[/b] — nearby NPCs may notice and react when they can see you kissing.[/*]
[*][b]Partner Reactions[/b] — your partner may become embarrassed and comment during public romantic moments.[/*]
[*][b]Spouses and Dating Partners[/b] — enjoy affectionate interactions before or after marriage.[/*]
[*][b]Polyamory Friendly[/b] — supports multiple romantic partners when used with polyamory mods.[/*]
[*][b]Custom NPC Support[/b] — romanceable NPCs from other mods can also participate.[/*]
[*][b]Custom Dialogue Packs[/b] — additional dialogue can be added for different characters and languages.[/*]
[/list]NPCs without custom dialogue are supported, so you can kiss them normally even if no special dialogue pack exists for them.
[heading][color=#c27ba0][size=4]Installation[/size][/color][/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b].[/*]
[*]Download and unzip [b][color=#c27ba0]Lots of Kisses[/color][/b] into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI and enjoy.[/*]
[/list][heading][color=#c27ba0][size=4]Requirements[/size][/color][/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or newer[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer[/*]
[/list][heading][color=#c27ba0][size=4]Optional[/size][/color][/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] — change the mod settings easily from inside the game.[/*]
[*][b]Tile Marker[/b] — a tool that lets you mark counters, tables, chairs, decorations, or other places that clearly shouldn’t block an NPC’s view. This is useful when a character can visually see your kiss but doesn’t react because the game treats a nearby piece of furniture as an obstacle. It only adjusts how Lots of Kisses checks visibility and doesn’t change the map, furniture, or collisions.[/*]
[/list][color=#c27ba0][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color]

Lots of Kisses is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10062]Hugs and Kisses[/url]. Both mods can be installed and used together.
Lots of Kisses 1.0.4 includes built-in compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35341]The Stardew Squad[/url]. Recruited spouses and dating partners can still receive Bump Kisses and Multi-Kisses while following you.
There is also an option in Generic Mod Config Menu that lets you choose whether kisses may temporarily interrupt a partner who is performing a Stardew Squad task. After the kiss ends, they will be released and can continue what they were doing. If this option is disabled, working partners won’t be interrupted, but idle or following partners can still be kissed normally. 💕

[color=#c27ba0][size=4][b]Player-to-Player Marriage — Experimental[/b][/size][/color]

The mod now includes experimental support for multiplayer couples where one farmer is married to another farmer. It works in both split-screen and online co-op, with support for Bump Kisses, automatic Multi-Kisses, and the mod’s manual kiss options.
For the best results, both players should have the same version of Lots of Kisses installed. Players can also choose whether they want to accept kisses from their farmer spouse through Generic Mod Config Menu.
Since this feature is still experimental, small visual or synchronization issues may occasionally happen depending on the platform or connection. If you encounter a problem, please send me your full SMAPI log and explain whether you were playing online or in split-screen so I can investigate it. 

Now go give your favorite person a kiss… or ten. 💖
